name: [⛄] Random Battlegrounds ⚔️
desc:
⚔️ Fight other players in this FFA combat game!
🎲 Weapons are randomized! Eliminate other players to get their weapons!
💨 Use trampolines, double jump and dash to quickly navigate around the map!
❓ Open lucky blocks to get more weapons!
⭐ Eliminate other players to gain bounty! Can you reach the highest bounty?


Controls:
Dash - C (on PC), R1 (on controller), Button (on mobile)
Double Jump - just like jump

Private Servers:
Press F4 to open the admin commands

Thumbnail artwork by @Angel_Void07

Tags:
Luckyblock, Battlegrounds, Random, Voxel, Blockgame, PvP
